subject: Overstated usage on Dec/Jan invoices — request for credit & VAT handling
messages:
From: Anna Keller <anna.keller@blueharbor.co>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: billing@blueharbor.co
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 17:15:00 +00:00
Subject: Billing discrepancy — duplicate compute counts on Dec/Jan invoices

Hi Nikhil,

Hope you had a good weekend. We were reviewing our December and January invoices and see what looks like duplicated compute consumption for several jobs tied to our nightly ingestion pipeline. Specifically:

- Invoice: invoice_2025-12_BlueHarbor.pdf — line items for model-infer-prod show 1,125,432 token units but our internal logs show ~562k for the same period.
- Invoice: invoice_2026-01_BlueHarbor.pdf — similar pattern across Jan 2–6 (re-tried jobs).

I attached both invoices to this email. Can you confirm whether any retry dedup logic failed on your side in late Dec? We need to reconcile amounts and determine whether a credit or refund is appropriate. Also, because we are VAT-registered in DE, please include the VAT treatment for any credit (credit note vs. invoice adjustment) so our tax team can process it.

Requested next steps:
1) A short explanation of the root cause (if applicable).
2) A proposed remediation (credit memo or invoice reissue) and whether VAT will be adjusted.
3) ETA for the credit posting or refund.

Thanks — looping in billing@blueharbor.co for PO/reference numbers.

Best,
Anna Keller
Head of Cloud Ops
BlueHarbor Ltd.

Attachments:
- invoice_2025-12_BlueHarbor.pdf (PDF)
- invoice_2026-01_BlueHarbor.pdf (PDF)
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Keller <anna.keller@blueharbor.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Billing discrepancy — duplicate compute counts on Dec/Jan invoices

Anna — thanks for the clear summary and for attaching the invoices.

Quick acknowledgement and proposed approach:
1) We see the same symptom in our usage logs: a small subset of jobs that retried early on Dec 30 had their retry IDs recorded as separate chargeable events due to an edge case in our job dedup index when a depended-on KV cache expired. This should not have charged twice; it’s a server-side attribution bug.

2) Remediation plan: our Finance team can either (A) issue a credit memo covering the overage across the two affected invoices, or (B) reissue corrected versions of the invoices. Practically, credit memo tends to be faster.

3) VAT: because the original invoices included EU VAT, we will issue a credit memo that explicitly references the original invoice numbers and the VAT lines — Grace (cc’d) will confirm the VAT convention we should follow for DE-registered customers.

Provisional offer: as a gesture of goodwill we’ll apply an additional service credit of €350 to offset the operational disruption while we finalize the exact overbilled token counts. We’ll provide a provisional credit amount by EOD Wednesday after a short usage reconcile.

Can you confirm the following so we can push the credit through quickly:
- Is there a PO number you want referenced on the credit memo?
- Do you prefer the credit to be applied to the next invoice or paid out as a refund?

Attaching a brief internal diagnostics snippet and our initial reconciliation request (internal).

Regards,
Nikhil Sharma
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

--

Subject: Credit memo issued: CM-2026-01 (BlueHarbor) — VAT note included

Hi Anna — following up with final numbers and documentation (apologies for the delay).

Summary of action taken:
- Root cause: retry deduplication edge-case confirmed; production fix deployed (December patch).
- Overbilled amount (net): €8,420.00 across the two invoices.
- Goodwill service credit: €350.00 (applied by Redwood).
- Total credit applied (net): €8,070.00.
- VAT (19% DE): VAT portion on credit: €1,533.30 — the credit memo references the original invoice VAT lines and reduces taxable amount accordingly.

Credit memo details:
- Credit memo ID: CM-2026-01
- References: invoice_2025-12_BlueHarbor, invoice_2026-01_BlueHarbor
- Credit posted to account on 20 Jan 2026; balance applied to the next outstanding invoice.

Attachments: BH_credit_memo_CM-2026-01.pdf (PDF) — includes VAT breakdown and ledger references for your accounting team. If you prefer a refund instead of applying the credit to next invoice, reply with bank details and we’ll initiate within 5–7 business days.

Additional notes:
- HubSpot record updated: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/DH-9876
- Doc reference: DocuSign envelope 0a1b2c3d (agreement addendum for invoice treatment).

If you need an EU VAT credit note with reverse-charge language instead, let me know and we’ll reissue to meet your tax team’s needs.

Thanks for your patience — we’ll follow up with a short post-mortem and the long-term remediation timeline.

Regards,
Grace O'Connor
Finance Manager, Billing Operations
Redwood Inference
